CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventory_overview()
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE v JSON;
BEGIN
  WITH pending AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, o.branch_id, SUM(oi.qty)::int AS qty,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)::int AS order_count
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')
    GROUP BY oi.product_id, o.branch_id
  )
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'stock_by_product_branch',
      (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(s)), '[]'::json)
         FROM (SELECT product_id, branch_id, qty FROM stock) s),
    'pending_order_summaries',
      (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(p)), '[]'::json) FROM pending p)
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_customers_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_group text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_debt_filter text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'date'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, name text, phone text, email text, address text, ward text, district text, province text, group_name text, customer_type text, company_name text, debt numeric, debt_adjustment numeric, total_buy numeric, total_paid numeric, total_paid_back numeric, computed_debt numeric, display_debt numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone, filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_search text := NULLIF(trim(coalesce(p_search,'')),'');
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT c.*
    FROM customers c
    WHERE
      (v_search IS NULL
        OR c.name  ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%'
        OR c.phone ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%'
        OR c.email ILIKE '%'||v_search||'%')
      AND (p_group IS NULL OR p_group = '' OR c.group_name = p_group)
  ),
  agg AS (
    SELECT
      b.id,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders o
        WHERE o.customer_id = b.id AND o.status = 'completed'
      ), 0)::numeric AS total_buy,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(v.amount) FROM cash_vouchers v
        WHERE v.payer_customer_id = b.id
          AND v.type = 'thu'
          AND (v.status IS NULL OR v.status <> 'cancelled')
      ), 0)::numeric AS total_paid,
      COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(v.amount) FROM cash_vouchers v
        WHERE v.receiver_customer_id = b.id
          AND v.type = 'chi'
          AND (v.status IS NULL OR v.status <> 'cancelled')
      ), 0)::numeric AS total_paid_back
    FROM base b
  ),
  enriched AS (
    SELECT
      b.id, b.name, b.phone, b.email, b.address, b.ward, b.district, b.province,
      b.group_name, b.customer_type, b.company_name,
      b.debt, COALESCE(b.debt_adjustment, 0) AS debt_adjustment,
      a.total_buy, a.total_paid, a.total_paid_back,
      (a.total_buy - a.total_paid + a.total_paid_back) AS computed_debt,
      (a.total_buy - a.total_paid + a.total_paid_back + COALESCE(b.debt_adjustment,0)) AS display_debt,
      b.created_at
    FROM base b
    JOIN agg a ON a.id = b.id
  ),
  filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM enriched e
    WHERE
      (p_debt_filter = 'all')
      OR (p_debt_filter = 'debt'    AND e.display_debt > 0)
      OR (p_debt_filter = 'no_debt' AND e.display_debt <= 0)
  ),
  total AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS c FROM filtered )
  SELECT
    f.id, f.name, f.phone, f.email, f.address, f.ward, f.district, f.province,
    f.group_name, f.customer_type, f.company_name,
    f.debt, f.debt_adjustment,
    f.total_buy, f.total_paid, f.total_paid_back,
    f.computed_debt, f.display_debt,
    f.created_at,
    (SELECT c FROM total) AS filtered_count
  FROM filtered f
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name'           THEN f.name        END ASC  NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'debt_desc'      THEN f.display_debt END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'debt_asc'       THEN f.display_debt END ASC  NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'total_buy_desc' THEN f.total_buy   END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'total_buy_asc'  THEN f.total_buy   END ASC  NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort NOT IN ('name','debt_desc','debt_asc','total_buy_desc','total_buy_asc')
         THEN f.created_at END DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.customer_stats()
 RETURNS TABLE(total_all_customers bigint, total_all_debt numeric, total_debtor_count bigint, total_sales numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH per AS (
    SELECT
      c.id,
      COALESCE(c.debt_adjustment, 0) AS adj,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders o
                WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed'), 0) AS total_buy,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(v.amount) FROM cash_vouchers v
                WHERE v.payer_customer_id = c.id AND v.type='thu'
                  AND (v.status IS NULL OR v.status<>'cancelled')), 0) AS total_paid,
      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(v.amount) FROM cash_vouchers v
                WHERE v.receiver_customer_id = c.id AND v.type='chi'
                  AND (v.status IS NULL OR v.status<>'cancelled')), 0) AS total_paid_back
    FROM customers c
  ),
  per2 AS (
    SELECT id, (total_buy - total_paid + total_paid_back + adj) AS display_debt, total_buy
    FROM per
  )
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM customers)                                   AS total_all_customers,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(display_debt) FROM per2 WHERE display_debt > 0), 0)   AS total_all_debt,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM per2 WHERE display_debt > 0)                 AS total_debtor_count,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_buy) FROM per2), 0)                             AS total_sales;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bulk_apply_stock_delta(p_branch text, p_deltas jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO stock (product_id, branch_id, qty)
  SELECT
    (elem->>'product_id')::text,
    p_branch,
    GREATEST(0, (elem->>'qty')::int)
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_deltas) AS elem
  ON CONFLICT (product_id, branch_id) DO UPDATE
    SET qty = GREATEST(0, stock.qty + EXCLUDED.qty);
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_orders_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_employee text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_customer text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_sort text DEFAULT 'date'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, code text, status text, customer_id text, customer_name text, customer_phone text, branch_id text, branch_name text, employee_id text, employee_name text, subtotal numeric, discount numeric, total numeric, deposit numeric, paid numeric, payment_method text, note text, created_at timestamp with time zone, completed_at timestamp with time zone, item_count integer, filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE v_total BIGINT;
BEGIN
  -- Đếm trước (1 lần) để gắn vào mọi dòng → client biết tổng để pagination.
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  WHERE (p_status   IS NULL OR o.status = p_status)
    AND (p_branch   IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch)
    AND (p_employee IS NULL OR o.employee_id = p_employee)
    AND (p_customer IS NULL OR o.customer_id = p_customer)
    AND (p_from     IS NULL OR o.created_at >= p_from)
    AND (p_to       IS NULL OR o.created_at <  (p_to + INTERVAL '1 day'))
    AND (
      p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
      o.code  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
      c.name  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
      c.phone ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
    );

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    o.id, o.code, o.status,
    o.customer_id, c.name, c.phone,
    o.branch_id, b.name,
    o.employee_id, u.full_name,
    o.subtotal, o.discount, o.total, o.deposit, o.paid,
    o.payment_method, o.note,
    o.created_at, o.completed_at,
    COALESCE(ic.item_count, 0)::int,
    v_total
  FROM orders o
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN branches  b ON b.id = o.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN users     u ON u.id = o.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id
  ) ic ON TRUE
  WHERE (p_status   IS NULL OR o.status = p_status)
    AND (p_branch   IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch)
    AND (p_employee IS NULL OR o.employee_id = p_employee)
    AND (p_customer IS NULL OR o.customer_id = p_customer)
    AND (p_from     IS NULL OR o.created_at >= p_from)
    AND (p_to       IS NULL OR o.created_at <  (p_to + INTERVAL '1 day'))
    AND (
      p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
      o.code  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
      c.name  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
      c.phone ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'total' THEN o.total END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'code'  THEN o.code  END ASC  NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'date' OR p_sort IS NULL
         THEN COALESCE(o.completed_at, o.created_at)
    END DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_products_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_brand text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'name'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, sku text, name text, category_id text, brand_id text, power text, color text, blade_size text, image_url text, description text, cost_price numeric, sale_price numeric, min_stock integer, tech_fee numeric, total_stock bigint, filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE v_total BIGINT;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total
  FROM products p
  WHERE (p_category IS NULL OR p.category_id = p_category)
    AND (p_brand    IS NULL OR p.brand_id    = p_brand)
    AND (p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
         p.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         p.sku  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%');

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, p.brand_id,
    p.power, p.color, p.blade_size, p.image_url, p.description,
    p.cost_price, p.sale_price, p.min_stock, p.tech_fee,
    COALESCE(s.total_stock, 0),
    v_total
  FROM products p
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(qty)::bigint AS total_stock FROM stock WHERE product_id = p.id
  ) s ON TRUE
  WHERE (p_category IS NULL OR p.category_id = p_category)
    AND (p_brand    IS NULL OR p.brand_id    = p_brand)
    AND (p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
         p.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         p.sku  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%')
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'sku'   THEN p.sku END ASC,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'price' THEN p.sale_price END DESC,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name' OR p_sort IS NULL THEN p.name END ASC
  LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_cash_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_fund text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, code text, type text, fund_type text, branch_id text, amount numeric, voucher_type_id text, from_kind text, from_id text, from_name text, to_kind text, to_id text, to_name text, payer_customer_id text, payer_customer_name text, receiver_customer_id text, receiver_customer_name text, collector_user_id text, payer_user_id text, note text, accounting boolean, status text, created_by text, created_at timestamp with time zone, filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE v_total BIGINT;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total
  FROM cash_vouchers v
  LEFT JOIN customers cp ON cp.id = v.payer_customer_id
  LEFT JOIN customers cr ON cr.id = v.receiver_customer_id
  WHERE (p_type   IS NULL OR v.type      = p_type)
    AND (p_fund   IS NULL OR v.fund_type = p_fund)
    AND (p_branch IS NULL OR v.branch_id = p_branch)
    AND (p_status IS NULL OR v.status    = p_status)
    AND (p_from   IS NULL OR v.created_at >= p_from)
    AND (p_to     IS NULL OR v.created_at <  (p_to + INTERVAL '1 day'))
    AND (p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
         v.code ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         v.note ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         cp.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         cr.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%');

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v.id, v.code, v.type, v.fund_type, v.branch_id,
    v.amount, v.voucher_type_id,
    v.from_kind, v.from_id, v.from_name,
    v.to_kind,   v.to_id,   v.to_name,
    v.payer_customer_id, cp.name,
    v.receiver_customer_id, cr.name,
    v.collector_user_id, v.payer_user_id,
    v.note, v.accounting, v.status,
    v.created_by, v.created_at,
    v_total
  FROM cash_vouchers v
  LEFT JOIN customers cp ON cp.id = v.payer_customer_id
  LEFT JOIN customers cr ON cr.id = v.receiver_customer_id
  WHERE (p_type   IS NULL OR v.type      = p_type)
    AND (p_fund   IS NULL OR v.fund_type = p_fund)
    AND (p_branch IS NULL OR v.branch_id = p_branch)
    AND (p_status IS NULL OR v.status    = p_status)
    AND (p_from   IS NULL OR v.created_at >= p_from)
    AND (p_to     IS NULL OR v.created_at <  (p_to + INTERVAL '1 day'))
    AND (p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
         v.code ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         v.note ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         cp.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         cr.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%')
  ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
  LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_schedules_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, title text, type text, status text, scheduled_date date, scheduled_time text, customer_id text, customer_name text, customer_phone text, branch_id text, branch_name text, order_id text, order_code text, address text, note text, work_type_id text, created_by text, assigned_by text, created_at timestamp with time zone, assignee_ids text[], filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE v_total BIGINT;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total
  FROM schedules s
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
  WHERE (p_status IS NULL OR s.status = p_status)
    AND (p_type   IS NULL OR s.type   = p_type)
    AND (p_branch IS NULL OR s.branch_id = p_branch)
    AND (p_from   IS NULL OR s.scheduled_date >= p_from)
    AND (p_to     IS NULL OR s.scheduled_date <= p_to)
    AND (p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
         s.title ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         c.name  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         c.phone ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%');

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    s.id, s.title, s.type, s.status,
    s.scheduled_date, s.scheduled_time,
    s.customer_id, c.name, c.phone,
    s.branch_id, b.name,
    s.order_id, o.code,
    s.address, s.note, s.work_type_id,
    s.created_by, s.assigned_by, s.created_at,
    COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(a.user_id) FROM schedule_assignments a WHERE a.schedule_id = s.id), '{}'),
    v_total
  FROM schedules s
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN branches  b ON b.id = s.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN orders    o ON o.id = s.order_id
  WHERE (p_status IS NULL OR s.status = p_status)
    AND (p_type   IS NULL OR s.type   = p_type)
    AND (p_branch IS NULL OR s.branch_id = p_branch)
    AND (p_from   IS NULL OR s.scheduled_date >= p_from)
    AND (p_to     IS NULL OR s.scheduled_date <= p_to)
    AND (p_search IS NULL OR p_search = '' OR
         s.title ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         c.name  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%' OR
         c.phone ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%')
  ORDER BY s.scheduled_date DESC, s.scheduled_time DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.autocomplete_customers(p_q text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, name text, phone text, debt numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT id, name, phone, debt
  FROM customers
  WHERE p_q IS NULL OR p_q = '' OR
        name  ILIKE '%' || p_q || '%' OR
        phone ILIKE '%' || p_q || '%'
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_q IS NOT NULL AND name ILIKE p_q || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    name
  LIMIT p_limit;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.autocomplete_products(p_q text, p_branch text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, sku text, name text, sale_price numeric, stock_qty bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.sale_price,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(qty) FROM stock s
                   WHERE s.product_id = p.id
                     AND (p_branch IS NULL OR s.branch_id = p_branch)), 0)::bigint
  FROM products p
  WHERE p_q IS NULL OR p_q = '' OR
        p.name ILIKE '%' || p_q || '%' OR
        p.sku  ILIKE '%' || p_q || '%'
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_q IS NOT NULL AND p.name ILIKE p_q || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    p.name
  LIMIT p_limit;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_dashboard(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_branch text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_from DATE := COALESCE(p_from, (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')::date);
  v_to   DATE := COALESCE(p_to,   CURRENT_DATE);
  v_result JSON;
BEGIN
  WITH completed AS (
    SELECT o.* FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.created_at >= v_from
      AND o.created_at <  (v_to + INTERVAL '1 day')
      AND (p_branch IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch)
  ),
  by_day AS (
    SELECT to_char(date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), 'MM-DD') AS d,
           SUM(total)::numeric AS revenue
    FROM completed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
  ),
  top_prod AS (
    SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.qty)::int AS qty
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN completed o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products  p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 10
  ),
  by_branch AS (
    SELECT b.name, COALESCE(SUM(c.total),0)::numeric AS revenue, COUNT(c.id)::int AS orders
    FROM branches b
    LEFT JOIN completed c ON c.branch_id = b.id
    GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY revenue DESC
  ),
  by_employee AS (
    SELECT u.full_name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(c.total),0)::numeric AS revenue
    FROM users u
    LEFT JOIN completed c ON c.employee_id = u.id
    GROUP BY u.full_name ORDER BY revenue DESC
  ),
  low_stock AS (
    SELECT p.name, p.sku, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty),0)::int AS qty, p.min_stock AS min
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.sku, p.min_stock
    HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.qty),0) <= p.min_stock
    ORDER BY qty ASC LIMIT 20
  ),
  debtors AS (
    SELECT id, name, phone, debt FROM customers
    WHERE debt > 0 ORDER BY debt DESC LIMIT 20
  ),
  totals AS (
    SELECT
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) FROM completed)             AS total_revenue,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)               FROM completed)             AS total_orders,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debt),0)  FROM customers WHERE debt>0) AS total_debt,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)               FROM products)              AS product_count,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)               FROM customers)             AS customer_count
  )
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'totalRevenue',  (SELECT total_revenue FROM totals),
    'totalOrders',   (SELECT total_orders  FROM totals),
    'totalDebt',     (SELECT total_debt    FROM totals),
    'productCount',  (SELECT product_count FROM totals),
    'customerCount', (SELECT customer_count FROM totals),
    'days',          (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(by_day)), '[]'::json)      FROM by_day),
    'topProducts',   (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(top_prod)), '[]'::json)    FROM top_prod),
    'byBranch',      (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(by_branch)), '[]'::json)   FROM by_branch),
    'byEmployee',    (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(by_employee)), '[]'::json) FROM by_employee),
    'lowStock',      (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(low_stock)), '[]'::json)   FROM low_stock),
    'debtors',       (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(debtors)), '[]'::json)     FROM debtors)
  ) INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_orders_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_tab text DEFAULT 'orders'::text, p_branch_ids text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, code text, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, completed_at timestamp with time zone, total numeric, customer_id text, customer_name text, branch_id text, branch_name text, schedule_count bigint, filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT
      o.id,
      o.code,
      o.status,
      o.created_at,
      o.completed_at,
      o.total,
      o.customer_id,
      c.name AS customer_name,
      o.branch_id,
      b.name AS branch_name,
      -- Ngày dùng để sort: GIỮ NGUYÊN logic client — đơn hoàn tất dùng completed_at,
      -- còn lại dùng created_at.
      (CASE WHEN o.status = 'completed' AND o.completed_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN o.completed_at ELSE o.created_at END) AS sort_date
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN branches  b ON b.id = o.branch_id
    WHERE
      (p_branch_ids IS NULL OR o.branch_id = ANY (p_branch_ids))
      AND (CASE WHEN p_tab = 'reserved'
                THEN o.status = 'reserved'
                ELSE o.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'reserved' END)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR p_status = '' OR o.status = p_status)
      AND (p_branch IS NULL OR p_branch = '' OR o.branch_id = p_branch)
      AND (
        p_search IS NULL OR p_search = ''
        OR o.code  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
        OR c.name  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
      )
  ),
  counted AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS n FROM base)
  SELECT
    base.id,
    base.code,
    base.status,
    base.created_at,
    base.completed_at,
    base.total,
    base.customer_id,
    base.customer_name,
    base.branch_id,
    base.branch_name,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM schedules s WHERE s.order_id = base.id) AS schedule_count,
    (SELECT n FROM counted) AS filtered_count
  FROM base
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'total_desc' THEN base.total END DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'total_asc'  THEN base.total END ASC  NULLS LAST,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'oldest'     THEN base.sort_date END ASC,
    -- mặc định + 'newest' + giá trị lạ: mới nhất trước
    CASE WHEN p_sort NOT IN ('total_desc','total_asc','oldest')
         THEN base.sort_date END DESC
  LIMIT  GREATEST(p_limit, 1)
  OFFSET GREATEST(p_offset, 0);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.orders_stats(p_branch_ids text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(reserved_count bigint, total_orders bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'reserved')::BIGINT AS reserved_count,
    COUNT(*)::BIGINT                                    AS total_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE p_branch_ids IS NULL OR branch_id = ANY (p_branch_ids);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_products_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_brand text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, sku text, name text, category_id text, brand_id text, cost_price numeric, sale_price numeric, min_stock integer, image_url text, total_stock numeric, stock_by_branch jsonb, filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH prod AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category_id, p.brand_id,
           p.cost_price, p.sale_price, p.min_stock, p.image_url
    FROM products p
    WHERE (p_search IS NULL OR p_search = ''
           OR p.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
           OR p.sku  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%')
      AND (p_category IS NULL OR p_category = '' OR p.category_id = p_category)
      AND (p_brand    IS NULL OR p_brand    = '' OR p.brand_id    = p_brand)
  ),
  counted AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS n FROM prod),
  page AS (
    SELECT * FROM prod
    ORDER BY name ASC
    LIMIT GREATEST(p_limit, 1) OFFSET GREATEST(p_offset, 0)
  )
  SELECT
    page.id, page.sku, page.name, page.category_id, page.brand_id,
    page.cost_price, page.sale_price, page.min_stock, page.image_url,
    COALESCE(st.total_stock, 0)                AS total_stock,
    COALESCE(st.stock_by_branch, '[]'::JSONB)  AS stock_by_branch,
    (SELECT n FROM counted)                    AS filtered_count
  FROM page
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(s.qty) AS total_stock,
           jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('branch_id', s.branch_id, 'qty', s.qty)) AS stock_by_branch
    FROM stock s
    WHERE s.product_id = page.id
  ) st ON TRUE
  ORDER BY page.name ASC;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.products_stats()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total_products', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products),
    'low_stock_count', (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p
      WHERE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.qty) FROM stock s WHERE s.product_id = p.id), 0) <= p.min_stock
    ),
    'categories', COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'name', c.name) ORDER BY c.name) FROM categories c),
      '[]'::JSONB),
    'brands', COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', b.id, 'name', b.name) ORDER BY b.name) FROM brands b),
      '[]'::JSONB),
    'branches', COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', br.id, 'name', br.name) ORDER BY br.name) FROM branches br),
      '[]'::JSONB)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_inventory_page(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'name'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, sku text, name text, min_stock integer, total_stock numeric, total_pending numeric, total_pending_orders bigint, branches jsonb, filtered_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH scope_branches AS (
    SELECT b.id, b.name
    FROM branches b
    WHERE p_branch IS NULL OR p_branch = '' OR b.id = p_branch
  ),
  prod AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.min_stock
    FROM products p
    WHERE p_search IS NULL OR p_search = ''
       OR p.name ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
       OR p.sku  ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
  ),
  prod_stock AS (
    SELECT p.id AS product_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0)::NUMERIC AS total_stock
    FROM prod p
    CROSS JOIN scope_branches sb
    LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = p.id AND s.branch_id = sb.id
    GROUP BY p.id
  ),
  counted AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS n FROM prod),
  page AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.min_stock, ps.total_stock
    FROM prod p
    JOIN prod_stock ps ON ps.product_id = p.id
    ORDER BY
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name'     THEN p.name         END ASC,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'sku'      THEN p.sku          END ASC,
      CASE WHEN p_sort = 'stock_asc' THEN ps.total_stock END ASC,
      CASE WHEN p_sort NOT IN ('name','sku','stock_asc') THEN ps.total_stock END DESC,
      p.name ASC
    LIMIT  GREATEST(p_limit, 1)
    OFFSET GREATEST(p_offset, 0)
  )
  SELECT
    page.id,
    page.sku,
    page.name,
    page.min_stock,
    page.total_stock,
    COALESCE(pend.total_pending, 0)        AS total_pending,
    COALESCE(pend.total_pending_orders, 0) AS total_pending_orders,
    br.branches,
    (SELECT n FROM counted)                AS filtered_count
  FROM page
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'branch_id',      sb.id,
               'branch_name',    sb.name,
               'stock',          COALESCE(s.qty, 0),
               'pending_qty',    COALESCE(pp.qty, 0),
               'pending_orders', COALESCE(pp.order_count, 0)
             )
             ORDER BY sb.name
           ) AS branches
    FROM scope_branches sb
    LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.product_id = page.id AND s.branch_id = sb.id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT o.branch_id,
             SUM(oi.qty)          AS qty,
             COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count
      FROM order_items oi
      JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
      WHERE oi.product_id = page.id
        AND o.status IN ('reserved','draft')   -- FIX: whitelist thay blacklist
      GROUP BY o.branch_id
    ) pp ON pp.branch_id = sb.id
  ) br ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM(oi.qty)          AS total_pending,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS total_pending_orders
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE oi.product_id = page.id
      AND o.status IN ('reserved','draft')     -- FIX: whitelist thay blacklist
      AND (p_branch IS NULL OR p_branch = '' OR o.branch_id = p_branch)
  ) pend ON TRUE
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'name'      THEN page.name        END ASC,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'sku'       THEN page.sku         END ASC,
    CASE WHEN p_sort = 'stock_asc' THEN page.total_stock END ASC,
    CASE WHEN p_sort NOT IN ('name','sku','stock_asc') THEN page.total_stock END DESC,
    page.name ASC;
$function$
